_provenance.note: Illinois citation authorities. IDHS publishes a PAIRED manual: the Policy Manual (PM) states the rule narratively, the Workers' Action Guide (WAG) at the SAME section number carries the operational detail and dollar tables — cited here as 'PM NN-NN-NN' / 'WAG NN-NN-NN'. Amendments issue as numbered Manual Releases ('MR #25.33') with public bulletin pages at dhs.state.il.us, and interim guidance issues as unnumbered Policy Memoranda before the next Manual Release folds it into PM/WAG text. Every PM/WAG page's own TOC listing carries a revision date + MR number — the best per-section freshness signal fetched live in this pass (some sections, e.g. PM 13-01-04, are visibly stale — see PROVENANCE.md).

ilpm.note: expedited SNAP application overview
who can get expedited service — <$150 gross + ≤$100 liquid, or destitute migrant, or rent+utilities exceed income+assets
expedited processing — Mercury/Illinois Link benefits issue same day as certification
SNAP Work Provisions and Sanctions — the broader work-registration ladder, distinct from the ABAWD-specific Work Requirement
SNAP Work Requirement — fixed 3-year clock 1/1/2024–12/31/2026, post-OBBBA exemptions
Convicted Persons and Persons Fleeing the Law — no drug-felony-conviction category (verified full opt-out is a separate statute, 305 ILCS 5/1-10(c))
SNAP units with elderly or disabled ('Qualifying') members — the 200% screen trigger
Qualifying Member definition — 60+ or disabled
Qualifying Member benefits — 200% gross screen, net-only test, LIHEAP-linked utility standard
categorically eligible SNAP households — the Guide to Services (DHS 4474) TANF-info-brochure pathway
benefits of categorical eligibility — no gross/net/asset test
households NOT categorically eligible — IPV, work sanction, over-200% qualifying-member, post-lottery reapplication
SNAP asset limits — $3,000/$4,500, waived for cat-el
licensed vehicles — excluded (mirrors federal default)
substantial lottery/gambling winnings — $4,500 single-game threshold, immediate ineligibility
SNAP monthly income standards overview — gross vs net, when each applies
gross monthly income — child-support exclusion applied BEFORE the gross-standard comparison
net monthly income
standard deduction — STALE PAGE (last revised 06/13/11, MR 11.13); see MR #25.33 and PROVENANCE.md for the discrepancy this creates
Standard Medical Deduction — $185 general / $485 Group Home-CILA, $35 floor, Qualifying Member only
dependent care deduction — actual cost, client statement, no verification required
child support income EXCLUSION — subtracted from gross for the income-standard comparison, NOT allowed again as a net-calc deduction
excess shelter deduction overview
the utility allowance — 4-tier ladder (A/C-Heating, Limited, Single, Telephone), post-OBBBA LIHEAP-eligibility narrowing for non-Qualifying-Member households eff. 9/26/2025
SNAP approval period overview
assigning a SNAP approval period — 6-month default, 24-month EDSRP (elderly/disabled)
Simplified Reporting status SNAP
SNAP Employment & Training (E&T) — voluntary program, not a regaining requirement itself but hosts Community Workfare/job search components that can meet the Work Requirement
